hypothesis: Two rather than four warps may reduce reduction/occupancy costs for the dominant Q8_0 four-column MMVQ variant on sm_121
basis: The accepted full-lifetime CLI profile assigns 31.08% of summed kernel duration to this variant; this is prioritization evidence, not a predicted end-to-end gain
candidate: Only calc_nwarps: return 2 for MMVQ_PARAMETERS_GB10, Q8_0 and ncols_dst=4. Preserve every other type, batch, architecture and kernel implementation.

source.build: Reuse the pinned Release CUDA build and rebuild only ggml-cuda. Copy the candidate DLL into an isolated runtime, then restore the original source and build DLL. The installed runtime remains untouched.

correctness.supplemental: Existing generic-op file loader, with original GGUF Q8_0 hyper-connection and attention/SSM projection shapes at 1, 4 and 8 columns
correctness.threshold: Existing MUL_MAT NMSE limit 5e-4; require every supported selected case to pass on the control and candidate

speed_screen.recipe: Installed original target, Q4_K draft, MTP3/ub512, dynamic vocabulary 16384; only candidate ggml-cuda.dll differs
speed_screen.promotion: Requires subsequent quality and repeated deployed-stack confirmation; no automatic deployment from an initial screen

stop_policy: Stop on correctness failure or first-pair speed failure; do not run a parameter sweep
